def make_base(self):
    shape = cq.Workplane('XY').box(self.length, self.width, self.height)
    self.box = shape
    self.model = shape

name: Revolve Sketch
description: Revolves a zigzag profile to create a central shape.
code:
def revolve_sketch(self):
    pts = [
        (self.p1_x, self.p1_y),
        (self.p2_x, self.p2_y),
        (self.p3_x, self.p3_y),
        (self.p4_x, self.p4_y),
        (self.p5_x, self.p5_y),
        (self.p6_x, self.p6_y),
        (self.p7_x, self.p7_y),
        (self.p8_x, self.p8_y),
        (self.p9_x, self.p9_y)
    ]
    profile = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=2.5).polyline(pts).close()
    revolved = profile.revolve(360, (0,0,0), (1,0,0))
    self.model = self.model.union(revolved)
